description: This file contains implementation of functions related to X509_CERT_AUX structure, specifically a print routine for auxiliary certificate information, including trust and reject sets, alias, and key ID. It is part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library, focusing on X.509 certificate auxiliary data handling.

methods.name: X509_CERT_AUX_print
methods.description: Prints auxiliary X.509 certificate data including trust, reject sets, alias, and key ID to a BIO output with specified indentation.
